segments.name: Reinforcement Materials
segments.description: Manufactures reinforcing carbons and elastomer composites for tire and industrial product applications.
segments.evidence: Our reinforcing carbons products are used in tires and industrial products.

segments.name: Performance Chemicals
segments.description: Produces specialty chemicals and performance materials including fumed metal oxides, conductive additives, and related products.
segments.evidence: Our business is currently organized into two reportable segments: Reinforcement Materials and Performance Chemicals.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase reinforcing carbons and specialty compounds for incorporation into their products, with pricing adjusted for feedstock costs.
revenueModel.evidence: These arrangements typically provide for sales price adjustments to account for changes in relevant feedstock costs including natural gas and, in many cases, changes in other relevant costs
